monument_type_scaffold.canonical_h1_instruction: Emit H1 (`# ...`) at the primary printed book divisions of the Horologion/Chasoslov: `# PREFACE`, `# THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE AND MATINS`, `# THE ORDER OF THE HOURS AND TYPIKA` (or `# THE ORDER OF VESPERS AND COMPLINE`), `# TROPARIA AND KONTAKIA OF THE MENOLOGION`, `# KANONIKON AND SUPPLICATORY CANONS`, `# SELECTED PSALMS FOR FEASTS`, and `# THE PASCHALION AND CALENDAR TABLES`.
prompt_guardrails: Never expand abbreviated Slavonic prayer cues (*Тр̃е*, *Ѻ̃че нашъ*, *Г̃и помилуй*) beyond their canonical English equivalent ('*Trisagion*', '*Our Father*', '*Lord, have mercy*') (Rule 16).

Emit H1 (`# ...`) at primary Horologion section boundaries (`# THE ORDER OF THE TYPIKA...`, `# TROPARIA AND KONTAKIA...`, `# SELECTED PSALMS...`, `# THE PASCHALION...`) so the Menologion, Selected Psalms, and Paschalion slice into distinct modular Parts.
Always parenthesize Cyrillic table letters and Slavonic incipits `(*...*)`, never square brackets `[...]`.
